- `GET /api/v1/catalog/{kind}` — Public: the published issuers, verifiers or mediators, newest first

## Public: the published issuers, verifiers or mediators, newest first

`GET /api/v1/catalog/{kind}` · public

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | path | `issuers`, `verifiers`, `mediators` |  |
| `limit` *(optional)* | query | integer | ≥ 1, ≤ 100, default `20` |
| `cursor` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 300 |
| `q` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 100 |
| `grants` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 64 |
| `tenant` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 255 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [CatalogPage](/reference/api/schemas/#catalogpage) |
| 422 | [`grants_issuers_only`](/reference/errors/#grants_issuers_only): `grants` filters issuers; [`tenant_required`](/reference/errors/#tenant_required): a tenant's own type (`custom:{key}`) is named in its tenant |
